reason: #939 made NotebookService.policy, AutomationRuntimeManager.update_project_policy and WorkspaceService.download async but two Butler actions still called them without await. nebula.settings.set_notebook raised AttributeError ('coroutine' object has no attribute execution_mode/approval_policy/host_access_acknowledged) on every mode or network change and saved nothing; its policy update was also un-awaited, and a mode change never called finish_policy_change, so a prepared change left the project's notebook admission paused ('Project mode is changing') until Core restarted. nebula.data.create_starter_files wrote the templates, then its read-back crashed ('coroutine' object has no attribute 'stream'), so Butler reported a failure and a retry was refused. The fix awaits all three calls, releases the mode change in a finally block like the Project settings route, and awaits the download on the loop with only the stream read in a thread. Selected: two new Butler set_notebook regressions over a real NotebookService and AutomationRuntimeManager (both fail on main), the Butler administration suite (its two starter-template cases are this defect's regression and fail on main), the other Butler notebook cases that pass on main, the guides starter-files route, the Settings API policy suite (the Project settings automation-policy route the fix mirrors) and the settings-assistant tool cases that pass on main.
exclusions: No full suites. tests/v3/test_butler_notebook.py: 5 package/restart/run cases fail identically on pristine origin/main (TypeError: object AutomationProjectPolicy can't be used in 'await' expression, from a sync test double of the now-async policy) and are not selected. tests/v3/test_settings_assistant_tools.py::test_catalog_covers_settings_destinations_without_secrets and ::test_provider_tools_are_bounded_to_catalog_and_project fail identically on main (the catalog gained nebula.settings.apply_memory_limit) and are not selected. test_butler_settings_consent.py (9 test-side un-awaited coroutines), test_butler_setup_controls.py (9, load-sensitive and StopIteration failures on main) and test_butler_capabilities.py::test_global_chat_settings_read_runs_outside_event_loop fail on main and on this branch and do not reach the changed code, so they are not selected. No UI, native or Playwright cases: no frontend code changed. Real-Core evidence (scratch supervisor PostgreSQL Core, Butler provider chats driving nebula.capabilities.change through POST /api/v1/chat/completions, on this branch and on main) is in the PR body, not executed by CI. The harness Butler path was not exercised on a real Core (no inert harness account on this host); it calls the same set_notebook_settings and ButlerCapabilities.invoke the tests drive.
